name: Sparxie Unlimited Edition Collectible Plushie
description: Upon use, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by 24% for the next battle.
story:
A souvenir that {NICKNAME} sells on Planarcadia... Wait, no, you remember you bought a raccoon plushie! It was supposed to be the cute and mischievous figure of a little raccoon, so how'd it become a plush for this girl? How self-absorbed can one person be?

"No, so you just copied the name of Miss Sparkle's doll and the introductory text in the original? That's way too much, isn't it?"
"I'm not copying! I just switched the keywords with a single click~"
"If you switch it all over with a single click, it won't sound right, okay? 'A souvenir that {NICKNAME} sells on Planarcadia.' What's that supposed to mean? What kind of setting is that?"
"Hey, why do you have to be so serious?"
"That line is also mine! Don't say it!"
